description: Reported behavior/Issue: Power sensor reading failure

additional_info.subject: Urgent – Serial-Based Incident Report & Crisis Meeting Request (Siemens Chargers Sicharge D)
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
We are facing a critical situation. 50% of our Siemens chargers are currently down. We request immediate ticket creation and action plans for the failures listed below :
Charger SID – S/N: Y2/S2313522141001 – PTS DUFOUR (Le Havre)
Status: Error – Power sensor reading failure
Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1232322218 status)
Last status update: 16/11/2025 – 18:44:57
Charger SID – S/N: MP/R6 170002081 – Wheeltainer (Le Havre)
Status: Error – Power sensor reading failure
Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1231380033 status)
Last status update: 16/11/2025 – 18:49:12
Charger SID – S/N: Y2R0313281750001 – fault for several weeks
Status: Error – Vendor specific error
VendorErrorCode: DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4
Last status update: 14/11/2025 – 20:55:24
Existing open ticket for this charger: ID0460433-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/R0 313281750001] – CRM:03056000434. To this day, no action has been taken. Only emails, no concrete intervention. Please escalate immediately.
Charger SID – S/N: MP/R8 170002535 – TER TRANSPORTS (Courthézon)
Status: Error – Power sensor reading failure
Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1223421108 status)
Last status update: 16/11/2025 – 10:57:14
We require the following without delay:
Creation of the tickets above with full tracking numbers
A dated intervention schedule for each site
A crisis meeting this week (video call) to identify root causes and define long-term corrective actions
We cannot continue receiving emails without tangible resolution. Immediate action is expected.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

additional_info.subject: ID0461984-DC/Si-D/RF-[Multi] Power sensor reading failure CRM:03097000194
additional_info.body:
Dear
Malek
,
Following your report, and after checking and analyzing , we can confirm that out of the four charger IDs you sent, three of them are working properly. Only one charger, with ID
CBK8C9
, is showing an error flag:
DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4
, which is related to the door sensor.
Please make sure that the door is properly closed. If the door is closed and the charger is still showing the same error, let us know so we can send a technician on-site to check and resolve the issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
